name: ss33
description: ss33 Skill Store for Claude Code: project-aware skill search, native skill install with a lockfile, and opt-in prompt matching.

api_key.title: Skill Store API key
api_key.description: Raises the free-tier limit (5 searches/minute). Create one at https://ss33.ai/skills/account. Stored in your OS keychain; the plugin also copies it to ~/.config/ss33/config.json (0600) so /ss33 commands can use it.

prompt_matching.title: Suggest skills from your prompts
prompt_matching.description: Off by default. When on, each prompt (plus a short project summary, never source code) is sent to the Skill Store to look for a relevant skill; at most a few one-line hints per session. Leave off to send nothing until you search.
